cases.primary_source_locator: Sep22 company release body, lines 39-58 on web readback
primary_source_facts: Glencore to provide the planned Project SHIELD facility's black mass input and to take MHP/battery-grade lithium carbonate output under a binding commercial term sheet.
Estimated ten-year offtake value exceeds USD 1 billion based on Q2 2026 forecast prices; not current earned revenue, fixed guaranteed cash, or delivered material.
The parties target final definitive feedstock and offtake agreements by end of 2026.
cases.hold_reason: Definitive purchase/sale agreements, site completion, finance, and project-level contracted volume not verified.

cases.primary_source_locator: company NSE Regulation 30 filing, 4 pages, pp 1-3, paragraphs 15-29 and Annexure 61-102
primary_source_facts: LOA 500MW/1000MWh at INR 238000 per MW-month, MSETCL substation; estimated INR 2142 crore over 15 years.
LOA 400MW/800MWh at INR 240000 per MW-month, MSEDCL substation; estimated INR 1728 crore over 15 years.
Combined 900MW/1800MWh, estimated INR 3870 crore over 15 years and expected VGF INR 324 crore; not a lump-sum battery purchase price.
Both BESPAs still to be executed and scheduled commissioning dates follow future BESPA terms.
cases.hold_reason: Official 0.1P four judgments and baseline Related not complete; avoid asserting signed BESPA or commissioned systems.

cases.primary_source_locator: Chinese issuer release dated Sep11, main paragraphs 88-101 on web readback
primary_source_facts: Gotion reports winning the core 6GWh BESS equipment supply for three Saudi storage sites; projects under substantive construction.
ACWA signed on Aug20 three 15-year storage services agreements for Haden, Muwayh, AlKahfah at 500MW/2000MWh each; equipment supplier attribution is a later different type of contract milestone.
Saudi first-group procurement is 2GW/8GWh in locked Full; do not add 6GWh as entirely separate Saudi capacity.
cases.hold_reason: Company issuer does not name three sites in this article, and equipment contract award/volume delivery terms require independent matching.

cases.primary_source_locator: company issuer body Sep24, text lines 41-50 on web readback
primary_source_facts: ESR signed to acquire 100% of Aquila Clean Energy APAC from Aquila Group.
Aquila APAC has 1.6GW solar, wind and battery storage assets in operation, construction or advanced development; not 1.6GW of commissioned BESS.
Closing is expected by Q1 2027 subject to conditions; no completed acquisition asserted.
cases.hold_reason: Closing not achieved and battery share of mixed 1.6GW portfolio unknown.

cases.primary_source_locator: Glencore corporate release dated Sep23, body lines 242-258 on web readback
primary_source_facts: Glencore was selected as founding partner of VaultCo, a public-private U.S. strategic minerals reserve mechanism supported by EXIM.

Glencore's Sep23 issuer release headlines a USD 500 million minerals commitment; other headlines mention 1 billion in combined Glencore/Mercuria commitments, not USD 1 billion assigned to Glencore alone.
EXIM had already approved up to USD 10 billion for Project Vault in February 2026; Sep23 partner procurement milestone is not a brand-new USD 10 billion loan approval.
cases.four_judgment_scope: specific_private_supplier_partner_stage; financing terms and ownership not independently demonstrated
cases.hold_reason: Glencore release does not establish bank loan disbursement or definitive stockpile commodity quantity; distinguish existing federal loan authorization and counterpart commitments.
